channel.title: DE//AGENT — Learn the pattern. Install the skill. Run the pipeline.
channel.description: An open registry and learning platform for modern Data Engineering: tutorials, architecture patterns, agent skills, MCP servers, agents, hooks and production runbooks — each with provenance, license, compatibility and verification status.

item.title: DataHub MCP Server
item.description: Exposes a DataHub catalog: search entities, read lineage and schema, and inspect metadata, so an agent can answer "what is this table and what depends on it?".

item.title: dbt MCP Server
item.description: dbt Labs server that exposes project discovery, the semantic layer, and the dbt CLI (`run`, `test`, `compile`) as tools, so an agent can build and inspect models.

item.title: AWS MCP Servers (Labs)
item.description: A suite of AWS Labs servers — including documentation search, CDK/Terraform assistance, and service-specific servers — for agents working on AWS.

item.title: SQL Review
item.description: Reviews a SQL statement for fan-out joins, NULL-unsafe predicates, implicit casts, non-deterministic ordering, and functions that silently change grain.

item.title: Spark Data Quality Review
item.description: A review skill an agent runs against a Spark/PySpark transform. It checks null propagation, join fan-out, silent type coercion, non-deterministic row counts and missing post-write assertions, then reports findings as a diff-level list.

item.title: Fetch MCP Server
item.description: Retrieves a URL and converts it to markdown for the model. Commonly used to read documentation during a task.

item.title: Filesystem MCP Server
item.description: Reference server that exposes a sandboxed set of directories as readable and (optionally) writable tools. Useful for pipelines that operate on local files.

item.title: Git MCP Server
item.description: Exposes local Git operations — status, diff, log, commit, branch — as tools, so an agent can inspect history and prepare changes without shelling out blindly.

item.title: PostgreSQL MCP Server
item.description: Connects an agent to a Postgres database with a read-only query tool and schema introspection. The canonical example of a "database over MCP" server.

item.title: DE Data Toolkit
item.description: The opinionated starter plugin: SQL/Spark review skills, the destructive-SQL guard, a secret scanner and the file/git MCP servers, wired for data engineers.

item.title: SQL Reviewer
item.description: Review SQL before it merges, catching correctness bugs and fan-out joins.

item.title: Local Docker Data Stack
item.description: A docker-compose stack (Postgres, Kafka, MinIO, Spark, and a DuckDB CLI) for developing and testing pipelines entirely offline.

item.title: DuckDB Documentation
item.description: DuckDB's documentation — the embedded analytics SQL engine, Parquet and CSV readers, in-process query execution, and extensions (ICU, JSON, Parquet, Excel). The fastest way to make a pipeline testable locally; covers everything our SQL review and testing skills reference, plus the DuckDB docs themselves.

item.title: Model Context Protocol Specification
item.description: The Model Context Protocol Specification — definitive reference for transports (stdio, SSE, HTTP), tool definitions, resource templates, prompts, and the security model. The security section is required reading before connecting any MCP server to real data; the transport section explains stdio vs HTTP tradeoffs. The canonical reference for all MCP server implementations on this platform.

item.title: MCP Tool Contract Auditor
item.description: Inspects an MCP server's tool list and schemas, flags tools that can write, delete, spend money or exfiltrate data, and produces a least-privilege connection recommendation.

item.title: GitHub MCP Server
item.description: First-party GitHub server exposing repositories, issues, pull requests and code search, plus optional write operations.

item.title: Destructive SQL Guard
item.description: Intercept DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE-without-WHERE before an agent executes it.

item.title: Pipeline failed
item.description: A task or DAG run has failed and downstream work is blocked — triage, classify and recover.

item.title: Agent-in-the-Loop Review
item.description: Coding agents can do real data-engineering work, but can also ship a schema change or drop a table.

item.title: Apache Airflow Documentation
item.description: Airflow's documentation — DAG authoring, scheduling semantics and timetables, backfills and catchup, task state and retries, dynamic task mapping, and best practices. The scheduling and best-practices pages answer the idempotency and backfill questions our orchestration skills only sketch; read them before designing any recurring pipeline.

item.title: MCP Registry (official)
item.description: The official MCP Registry — community-driven registry of MCP servers with a metadata schema for discovery. The canonical place to discover MCP servers — treat entries as *discovery*, never as a trust signal. The metadata schema defines server capabilities, transport, and authentication; essential for building MCP-aware tooling.

item.title: dbt Test Writer
item.description: Proposes dbt tests ranked by blast radius: uniqueness/not-null on the grain key, accepted values on enums, relationships on foreign keys, and freshness on sources.

item.title: dbt Model Review
item.description: Checks a dbt model's grain statement, ref/dependency hygiene, incremental strategy and late-arriving-data handling, then proposes a test set.

item.title: DuckDB / MotherDuck MCP Server
item.description: Queries DuckDB databases and MotherDuck, including reading Parquet/CSV directly from object storage. Excellent for local, offline analysis with an agent.

item.title: dbt Workbench
item.description: Model review, test generation, incremental-safety checks and a full-refresh guard, plus the dbt MCP server for running commands from the agent.

item.title: Schema Change Check
item.description: Block a commit that introduces a breaking schema change without a migration plan.

item.title: Spark Optimizer
item.description: Diagnose and fix slow or expensive Spark jobs from their metrics.

item.title: PySpark Project Template
item.description: A testable PySpark project: src/transforms, tests with a local Spark session, a Dockerfile, and a Makefile that runs lint + tests offline.

item.title: API → S3 → Spark → Parquet
item.description: Land a paginated REST API into S3 raw, transform with PySpark into partitioned Parquet, and make the whole thing idempotent and testable offline.

item.title: Spark job is slow
item.description: A batch Spark job's runtime has jumped — find whether it is skew, partition count, spill or over-scan.

item.title: Medallion Zones (raw / curated / serving)
item.description: Object storage gives you a place to put files but no structure for trust or ownership.

item.title: Agent Skills (open format)
item.description: The Agent Skills format specification — a SKILL.md file with front-matter (name, description, version), plus references/, scripts/, and examples/ directories that an agent loads on demand. The format this platform's Skill object is modelled on — portable across compatible agents. Covers the SKILL.md schema, the directory layout convention, and the agent loading protocol.

item.title: Apache Spark Documentation
item.description: The authoritative reference for Spark SQL, the DataFrame API, tuning and the configuration catalogue, versioned per Spark release. Use it for exact semantics and config keys — when a job skews or slows, check the config reference and the tuning guide before changing code, alongside our skew-diagnosis and cost skills.

item.title: Pipeline Test Author
item.description: Builds a local DuckDB/pyarrow harness with tiny fixtures so pipeline logic is testable in CI without a cluster, and asserts on invariants, not snapshots.

item.title: Snowflake MCP Server (Labs)
item.description: Snowflake Labs server exposing object management and SQL execution against a Snowflake account, including Cortex Search and Analyst services.

item.title: Contract Kit
item.description: Authors data contracts, enforces them in CI, and classifies schema changes as compatible/risky/breaking for producers and consumers.

item.title: Pre-deployment DQ Check
item.description: Run the quality suite against a staged run before promoting to production.

item.title: dbt Project Template
item.description: A layered dbt project (staging/intermediate/marts) with tests, docs, a CI workflow that builds against a staging schema, and a source freshness config.

item.title: dbt → warehouse → tests → docs
item.description: Transform raw landed data into a tested, documented star schema with dbt, and gate every change on data-aware CI.

item.title: Data quality failure
item.description: A quality expectation failed in production and bad data may be reaching consumers.

item.title: Kafka consumer lagging
item.description: A consumer group is falling behind the topic and downstream tables are going stale.

item.title: Quarantine then Publish
item.description: One bad batch of rows can poison a whole table and every downstream metric.

item.title: Apache Kafka Documentation
item.description: Kafka's official documentation — architecture and design, delivery semantics, the protocol, consumer groups and offsets, operations, and security. The design section explains why ordering and partitions behave the way they do; the operations section companions our lag-triage skill and consumer-lag runbook when a group falls behind.

item.title: dbt Documentation
item.description: dbt's documentation — the analytics-engineering workflow, project structure with models and sources, materialisations and incremental-model patterns, tests (unique, not-null, relationships, accepted values) and the docs-as-data approach. The materialisation and incremental-model pages are the reference behind our dbt review and testing skills; pair with our warehouse-testing guide for the practical path.

item.title: Schema Change Contract Review
item.description: Diffs an old and new schema, classifies the change (compatible / risky / breaking) against consumers, and produces the migration and comms plan.

item.title: Spark Lens
item.description: Parses Spark event logs into a task histogram, flags skew and shuffle amplification, and compares against a stored cost baseline.

item.title: Secret Scan on Commit
item.description: Stop credentials from being committed into a pipeline repo.

item.title: Data Quality Reviewer
item.description: Audit a dataset or pipeline for the quality failures that reach consumers.

item.title: Pipeline → DQ → quarantine → publish
item.description: Put a contract in front of a table: validate each batch, publish the clean rows, quarantine the rest with reasons, and alert on the quarantine rate.

item.title: Schema drift
item.description: The upstream schema changed without notice and a cast broke or a column silently nulled.

item.title: dbt as Models + Tests + Docs
item.description: Transformation logic lives in untested, undocumented SQL scattered across scripts.

item.title: Incremental Batch with a Watermark
item.description: Full reloads are too slow and too expensive once a table grows past millions of rows.

item.title: dbt Best Practices Guide
item.description: dbt Labs' official best practices guide — project structure, staging/marts layering, naming conventions, testing conventions (unique, not_null, relationships, accepted_values), model contracts, and incremental model patterns. A widely-adopted convention set; agreeing on it early avoids enormous friction later. The testing conventions section directly backs our dbt test writer skill; the materialization guide supports our warehouse testing patterns.

item.title: Delta Lake Documentation
item.description: Delta Lake's official docs — ACID transactions on object storage, time travel, OPTIMIZE and Z-ORDER clustering, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog integration. The definitive source for Delta features and the maintenance operations our lakehouse skills reference; compare with our Delta vs Iceberg decision guide before committing to a format.

item.title: Incident Postmortem Writer
item.description: Structures incident notes into a blameless postmortem: timeline, impact, detection gap, contributing factors, and action items with owners and dates.

item.title: Runbook Runner
item.description: Loads the production playbooks into the agent, matches an alert to a runbook, and walks the operator through diagnosis and mitigation step by step.

item.title: Production Write Confirmation
item.description: Force human confirmation for any write against a production data target.

item.title: Incident Assistant
item.description: Guide an on-call engineer through a data incident and produce the postmortem.

item.title: Postgres → CDC → Kafka → Lakehouse
item.description: Capture changes from Postgres with Debezium, stream through Kafka, and merge into a lakehouse table with correct ordering, deletes and replay safety.

item.title: Backfill required
item.description: Historical output is wrong or missing and must be recomputed safely, without breaking production.

item.title: Spark job suddenly costs 4x
item.description: One job's compute cost quadrupled without an obvious functional change — attribute it and reverse the regression.

item.title: Postgres CDC to Lakehouse
item.description: Batch extraction from an OLTP database loads it and still misses deletes and mid-day changes.

item.title: Apache Iceberg Documentation
item.description: Iceberg's specification and documentation — the table format, snapshots and manifests, hidden partitioning, schema and partition evolution, and maintenance procedures like compaction and snapshot expiry. The table format is a specification, so the spec is the ground truth when engines disagree; essential reading for multi-engine shops where Spark, Trino, and warehouses share tables.

item.title: Airflow DAG Reviewer
item.description: Checks a DAG for non-idempotent tasks, unsafe retries, missing catchup policy, ambiguous catchup/backfill semantics and unbounded concurrency.

item.title: Spark Cost Check
item.description: Fail a build when a Spark job's shuffle/spill/scan metrics regress past a threshold.

item.title: Schema Reviewer
item.description: Classify schema changes and prevent breaking changes from shipping.

item.title: Airflow DAG Template
item.description: An idempotent DAG skeleton with task groups, retries and backoff, SLA, pools, and a sensor using reschedule mode.

item.title: CDC stopped
item.description: Change events stopped flowing from a source and the target table is silently diverging.

item.title: Idempotent Partition Overwrite
item.description: Retries and backfills duplicate or corrupt data because writes are appends.

item.title: Safe Backfill
item.description: Backfills corrupt production or take down the daily run.

item.title: Debezium Documentation
item.description: Debezium's documentation — source and sink connectors, the change-event envelope format, initial snapshots, schema history handling, and the operational pitfalls of running connectors in production. The connector matrix and the events section are what you need to design a correct CDC merge; pair with our Postgres CDC lakehouse project for the full path.

item.title: Snowflake Documentation
item.description: Snowflake's official documentation — comprehensive coverage of micro-partitions, clustering keys, virtual warehouses, streams and tasks, time travel, and zero-copy cloning. The performance and cost sections are the definitive reference for clustering-key design, warehouse sizing, and query optimization. The Snowflake Cortex and ML functions sections document built-in ML capabilities. The security chapter covers RBAC, network policies, and Tri-Secret Secure. Essential reading for anyone operating Snowflake at scale; pairs with our cost-engineering and warehouse-clustering skills.

item.title: Warehouse Explorer
item.description: Schema browsing, query-plan explanation, clustering advice and a read-only connection profile for Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift.

item.title: Pipeline Reviewer
item.description: Review a DAG or pipeline for idempotency, retries and backfill safety.

item.title: Data Contract Template
item.description: A contract skeleton (ownership, schema, semantics, SLA, compatibility policy) with the CI check that enforces it and a deprecation checklist.

item.title: Kafka → Spark Streaming → Delta
item.description: A low-latency stream into Delta Lake with watermarking, windowed aggregation and idempotent upserts that survive replays.

item.title: Duplicate records
item.description: Row counts are inflated and metrics double-counted after a retry, a fan-out join or a backfill.

item.title: Streaming Dedup and Upsert
item.description: Streaming sinks either duplicate on replay or lose rows on failure.

item.title: SQL Query Plan Explainer
item.description: Reads EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and explains scans, joins, spills and estimated-vs-actual row skew, then proposes the single highest-impact change.

item.title: Backfill Safety Check
item.description: Refuse to start a backfill that lacks a rollback path or overlaps the daily run.

item.title: S3 → Glue → Athena
item.description: A serverless, query-in-place pattern: land Parquet in S3, catalogue it with Glue, and query with Athena while keeping scanned bytes (and cost) low.

item.title: Small files explosion
item.description: A table has fragmented into thousands of tiny files and query planning now dominates runtime.

item.title: Compaction & File-Size Management
item.description: High-frequency writes shatter a table into thousands of tiny files and queries crawl.

item.title: Contracts as a Quality Gate
item.description: Producers change schemas and semantics with no notice; consumers break in production.

item.title: Great Expectations Documentation
item.description: Great Expectations documentation — expectations (expectations, suites, checkpoints) as a YAML DSL for data quality, plus the data-doc approach that connects quality rules to documentation. The expectation catalogue is a practical vocabulary for expressing rules with precision; pairs with our Soda Core reference and data-quality starter guide.

item.title: AWS Glue Job Reviewer
item.description: Reviews Glue/Spark jobs for worker sizing, job bookmarks, partition pruning, and the catalogue/schema pitfalls that cause silent full reprocessing.

item.title: Kafka Console
item.description: Topic inventory, per-partition lag triage, rebalance detection and a read-only message sampler with a PII redaction pass.

item.title: dbt Full-Refresh Guard
item.description: Require confirmation before a full-refresh of a large incremental model.

item.title: AWS Architecture Reviewer
item.description: Review an AWS data architecture for cost, IAM and reliability risks.

item.title: Kafka Streaming Job Template
item.description: A structured-streaming job with checkpointing, watermarking, a dedupe stage and an idempotent MERGE sink to Delta/Iceberg.

item.title: Data contract broken
item.description: A producer violated its contract and a consumer broke in production — bound the impact before fixing.

item.title: BigQuery Documentation
item.description: BigQuery's official documentation — comprehensive coverage of partitioning, clustering, slot management, and the query optimizer's behavior. Covers BigQuery ML, BI Engine, materialized views, and authorized views. The partitioning/clustering pages explain the exact levers for cost control; the query optimizer section explains slot utilization and query planning. Essential for our Athena/BigQuery cost comparison guide and BigQuery cost-optimization patterns.

item.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Triage
item.description: Triages consumer lag from the consumer-group offsets: distinguishing a slow consumer, a partitioned hot key, a rebalance storm, and a poison-pill retry loop.

item.title: BigQuery MCP Server
item.description: Community server for BigQuery that lists datasets and runs SQL against a project, with support for the BigQuery SQL dialect.

item.title: Lineage Graph
item.description: Column-level impact analysis over a lineage store, with a change-impact command that lists the downstream consumers a schema change would break.

item.title: PII Leak Guard
item.description: Prevent raw PII from entering model context or being written to an unprotected path.

item.title: Kafka Troubleshooter
item.description: Triage consumer lag, rebalance loops and poison messages in minutes.

item.title: Terraform AWS Data Platform
item.description: S3 buckets with lifecycle + encryption, Glue catalogue, IAM roles scoped to least privilege, and Athena workgroups with query limits.

item.title: Bad deployment
item.description: A deploy broke production; correlate the signal with the change and roll back first.

item.title: Dimensional Model (star schema)
item.description: Analysts re-derive the same joins and disagree on metric definitions.

item.title: Apache Parquet Documentation & Spec
item.description: Apache Parquet documentation and specification — columnar encoding, row groups, statistics, predicate pushdown, and how to structure files for efficient reads. Understanding statistics and row-group sizing is the practical step that turns "use Parquet" into "and lay out the file like this"; pairs with small-files and lambda-vs-kappa guides.

item.title: Backfill Planner
item.description: Produces a backfill plan: date ranges, blast radius, resource contention, idempotency check, validation gates and rollback.

item.title: Lakehouse Guard
item.description: Delta/Iceberg table maintenance advisor plus a guard that blocks compaction or snapshot expiry during peak ingestion windows.

item.title: Backfill Planner
item.description: Produce a safe, staged backfill plan with validation and rollback.

item.title: Late files
item.description: Partner files arrive after the job has already run, so historical numbers keep changing.

item.title: Cost Guardrails
item.description: A working pipeline silently becomes expensive and nobody notices until the invoice.

item.title: Databricks Documentation
item.description: Databricks Documentation — comprehensive coverage of Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, jobs and clusters, liquid clustering, Photon engine, and Unity Catalog governance. The Liquid Clustering and Unity Catalog pages are platform-specific and only documented here; the Delta Live Tables section is the definitive reference for building reliable pipelines. Essential for our lakehouse skills and Databricks-specific patterns.

item.title: Spark Skew Diagnosis
item.description: Walks an agent through reading the Spark UI/event log to distinguish key skew, partition skew, and shuffle-write amplification, then selects between salting, AQE skew join, broadcast, and repartition strategies.

item.title: Freshness Pre-Merge Check
item.description: Warn when a change would silently widen the freshness SLA of a source.

item.title: Databricks Reviewer
item.description: Review notebooks, jobs and Delta tables for the Databricks-specific pitfalls.

item.title: Warehouse query is slow
item.description: A query that used to be fast became slow — separate scan inefficiency from compute contention.

item.title: DataHub Documentation
item.description: DataHub's documentation — the open metadata model for ownership and lineage, ingestion framework, search, and governance integration. Explains how to represent ownership and lineage consistently across tools; the key vocabulary resource for any catalog-related pipeline design.

item.title: Warehouse Clustering Advisor
item.description: Advises on Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift tuning: clustering keys, warehouse sizing, result caching, and the difference between a scan problem and a compute problem.

item.title: Cost Lens
item.description: Attributes warehouse/cluster spend to pipelines, computes unit economics, and alerts on cost-per-run regressions rather than on total spend.

item.title: Lambda vs Kappa (batch + stream)
item.description: Streaming is fast but hard; batch is simple but slow; you need both speed and correctness.

item.title: AWS Glue Documentation
item.description: AWS Glue Documentation — complete reference for Glue jobs, crawlers, the Data Catalog, job bookmarks, DPU configuration, and Ray integration. The job bookmarks and catalog behavior sections are the source of the most common Glue surprises; the Spark UI integration pages explain how to debug slow jobs. Essential for our Glue review skills and CDC pipeline patterns.

item.title: Iceberg Table Maintenance
item.description: Diagnoses small-file and manifest bloat and generates the compaction, snapshot expiry and orphan-file cleanup plan for an Iceberg table.

item.title: Cost Optimizer
item.description: Reduce the unit cost of pipelines without breaking them.

item.title: Missing partition
item.description: An expected date partition is absent, so a downstream report silently excludes a day.

item.title: OpenLineage Documentation
item.description: OpenLineage documentation — the open specification for lineage events, plus integrations for Airflow, Spark and dbt. Not a tool or a service; it is a standard for emitting lineage events, which is what makes cross-tool lineage possible. Read it before wiring any line-tracking pipeline.

item.title: CDC Merge Designer
item.description: Produces a MERGE (or Delta/Iceberg merge) that applies inserts, updates and deletes from a CDC stream correctly, including out-of-order events and tombstones.

item.title: Kafka MCP Server
item.description: Community server for Apache Kafka that lists topics, reads consumer-group lag, and samples messages, for stream debugging from an agent.

item.title: Delta Optimization Advisor
item.description: Reads Delta table history and file statistics to decide between OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, liquid clustering and partitioning changes.

item.title: Spark Cost Regression Guard
item.description: Compares a job's shuffle/spill/scan metrics against a stored baseline and fails the change if cost-per-run regresses beyond a threshold, with the diff explained.

item.title: Data Vault (hubs, links, satellites)
item.description: Integrating many changing sources into a warehouse without constant rework.

item.title: Soda Core
item.description: Soda Core — open-source checks-as-code for data quality with a YAML DSL for column and row-level checks, metrics, and thresholds. The SQL-metric approach is easier to reason about than Great Expectations' expectation suites; the programmatic API enables CI/CD integration. Lightweight alternative to Great Expectations; pairs with our data-quality starter guide and Great Expectations reference.

item.title: Data Contract Author
item.description: Drafts a data contract (schema, semantics, freshness SLA, ownership, breaking- change policy) and the tests that enforce it in CI.

item.title: Athena Partition Advisor
item.description: Recommends partition projection, bucketing or file-layout changes to reduce Athena bytes-scanned, and writes the projection DDL.

item.title: Lineage Explainer
item.description: Traces column-level lineage from an asset to its upstream sources and downstream consumers, and reports the impact set for a proposed change.

item.title: Data Catalog Assistant
item.description: Answer "what is this data, who owns it, and is it safe to use?".

item.title: Data Mesh (O'Reilly)
item.description: Organizational principles for analytical data at scale — domain ownership, data as a product, self-serve data platform, and federated computational governance. Zhamak Dehghani's Data Mesh provides the organizational counterpoint to a central platform team; the vocabulary and principles are essential for governance discussions and platform strategy. The four principles (domain ownership, data as product, self-serve platform, federated governance) map directly to our governance and platform patterns.

item.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications (O'Reilly)
item.description: The canonical book on the principles behind data systems: reliability, scalability, replication, partitioning, consistency, and batch/stream processing. Martin Kleppmann's DDIA is the single highest-value read for system-design interviews and for understanding why data tools are shaped as they are. Every chapter maps directly to patterns in this registry — replication to CDC, partitioning to lakehouse, consistency to transaction semantics. The definitive textbook for data engineers.

item.title: Fundamentals of Data Engineering (O'Reilly)
item.description: A lifecycle view of data engineering — generation, storage, ingestion, transformation, and serving — with the "undercurrents" of security, governance, and cost. Joe Reis and Matt Housley provide a modern, practitioner-oriented map of the field. The best overview for someone moving into data engineering; pairs perfectly with this platform's roadmap. Covers the full lifecycle from ingestion through serving, with practical patterns for each stage.

item.title: Cost Unit-Economics Reporter
item.description: Turns cluster/warehouse billing into unit economics (cost per 1M rows, per run, per model) so a 4x regression shows up as a number, not a surprise invoice.

item.title: PII Classifier
item.description: Scans column names and sample values for PII categories, then proposes classification tags and a masking/pseudonymisation policy.

item.title: SQLFluff Core Rule Pack
item.description: A curated SQLFluff configuration with rules optimized for modern data engineering workflows. Includes dialect-specific rules for dbt (Jinja), Spark SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift. Enforces naming conventions, formatting standards, performance anti-patterns, and security rules.

item.title: Data Classification & Tagging Governance Pack
item.description: A complete governance pack for implementing data classification across your organization. Includes: standardized tag taxonomy (PII, PCI, confidential, public), business glossary terms, automated classification rules (regex, ML-based), and access policies by classification level. Integrates with DataHub, OpenMetadata, and native warehouse tagging.

item.title: OPA Data Access Control Policy
item.description: A comprehensive OPA policy bundle for enforcing data access controls across your data platform. Includes policies for: row-level security, column masking, table-level permissions, and audit logging. Compatible with Trino, Presto, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks via their OPA integrations.

item.title: Snowflake Warehouse Configuration Template
item.description: A comprehensive Snowflake warehouse configuration template covering: warehouse sizing, auto-suspend/resume, resource monitors for cost control, query acceleration, and multi-cluster settings. Includes environments for dev, staging, and production with appropriate defaults.

item.title: A DuckDB Database with No Data in It
item.description: A DuckDB database file does not have to hold any data. It can store nothing but view definitions that point at Parquet files on object storage, so a few hundred kilobytes behave like a shared catalog over a whole data lake. This post shows how to build one, host it, and attach it

item.description: Learn how to pair DuckDB with AWS Glue 6.0 to run SQL-centric ETL on a single worker, reading Parquet from Amazon S3 and writing Apache Iceberg tables to Amazon S3 Tables. This post walks through a complete, runnable example and compares measured cost and runtime against an equiv

item.description: Hugging Face hosts hundreds of thousands of datasets, and DuckDB can read them directly, exactly where they are and without downloading anything, over the DuckDB `hf://` protocol. This post looks at how the integration works and the scenarios where it works best.
